sentences.en: With these equations we have designed for helium-cadmium lasers a new type of helium replenisher, which has lengthened the life time of a He-Cd laser to over 1000 hours so far.

sentences.en: Especially beneficial around eyes, lips, neck and bust areas, this protein-rich replenisher is suitable for most skin types, especially dry and sun damaged skin.

sentences.en: Besides, light salt water is a good kind of replenisher to cure of serious dehydration and to ease patients' weakness.
sentences.vi: Bên cạnh đó, nước muối nhạt là một loại chất bổ sung tốt để chữa mất nước nghiêm trọng và làm dịu tình trạng suy nhược của bệnh nhân.

sentences.en: METHODS:The management mode of the botanical preparations in the USA and the related laws and regulations were overviewed from the perspectives of dietary replenisher and drug areas.
